name: 4p0q7c-tracker-launch-context
goal: A fresh tracker session loads bounded item history: tracker show and the launch brief stay small while every note stays readable in pages

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Sonnet launches reach 150k in 3-13 min (6kmyg7, gqrac3 transcripts): start about 46k, about 105k growth. tracker show 6kmyg7 prints 102,765 chars (212 notes); one run read about 80k chars of dumped notes. The brief and done-proof rule send sessions to show --json. Expected: bounded show and brief, every note readable in pages.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: tracker-cli-compat.test.ts exercised show only on an item with no history and tracker-host-brief.test.ts used notes_log: [], so no fixture or assertion bounded output size. Both suites gain long-history fixtures with size budgets and completeness assertions.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Recorded at b6e6aab71b: expected 95561 to be less than 16000 (show); brief recent notes 8570 over 6500.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Fix 68addd4698: bounded show with --notes-page, bounded brief notes without routine bookkeeping or a duplicated handoff, Keep context small rule, no --json history instructions.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: loop record green passed the unchanged tests at 68addd4698.

steps.title: Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
